Priya: quick flag  we keep getting support tickets where the python SDK surfaces a bare Exception and folks can't tell if it's auth vs rate limit. makes onboarding painful.
Ethan: can you paste an example?
Priya: sure, from a user repro: `Exception: Request failed (status=401)`. no structured fields, just args. they ended up retrying when they should re-auth.
Noah: we solved this in rust-sdk by introducing TypedError with fields: `status`, `kind`, `can_retry`. callers do `match err.kind` which is nice.
Zara: agreed. proposal: add an `ApiError` that always exposes `http_status` (int), `error_kind` (enum string), `retryable` (bool), and optional `retry_after` (int seconds). keep original response attached as `__cause__` for compatibility.
Priya: important for DX: sample apps should show the pattern. our current quickstart catches Exception and prints it; we should show `except ApiError as e:` and show branching logic.
Ethan: +1. also define canonical mapping in SDK-spec so every language maps 401->Unauthorized, 429->RateLimit, 5xx->ServerError, etc. prevents language divergence.
Noah: small nuance: 409 (Conflict) can be retryable if the request is idempotent and safe to retry after resolving. we should document that `retryable` may depend on HTTP method and idempotency.
Zara: i propose helper `should_retry(method)` on the ApiError that returns True/False taking method into account. keeps examples simple.
Priya: sample code idea for python quickstart:
```
try:
    res = client.create_session(...)
except ApiError as e:
    if e.retryable:
        backoff_and_retry()
    elif e.error_kind == "Unauthorized":
        refresh_creds()
    else:
        raise
```
This is clearer than the current dump.
Ethan: tests: add unit test mapping status codes to kinds, and an integration test that preserves underlying `requests.HTTPError` in `__cause__` so infra that checks headers still works.
Noah: compatibility note: some infra libs catch `requests.HTTPError`. we should either subclass it or set `__cause__` so `raise from` reveals it. i lean to setting `__cause__` rather than subclassing; less coupling.
Zara: also surface `retry_after` parsed from `Retry-After` header (int seconds) so clients can honor server hints.
Priya: docs: update SDK error page with table and examples in py/js/go/rust. maybe add a short migration guide: `if you were catching Exception, switch to ApiError` with snippet.
Ethan: operational: add a changelog entry and note minor semver risk for python (new attributes only). include MIGRATION.md.
Noah: could we also add an enum `ApiErrorKind` with values: Unauthorized, Forbidden, NotFound, Conflict, RateLimit, ServerError, Unknown. keeps consumption simple.
Zara: agreed. include `details` freeform string for things like `quota exceeded for org X` so UX can show more context.
ci-bot: ci: py-sdk/tests: mapping_tests.py passed (7/7) at 2024-11-11T09:12:30Z
Ethan: great. next steps: (1) PR SDK-spec mapping (2) PR py-sdk ApiError implementation + tests + MIGRATION.md (3) update quickstart sample to demonstrate handling (4) docs update.
Priya: i'll draft the py PR, include `__cause__` assignment and `should_retry()` helper.
Noah: i'll add idempotency tests and a small integration that asserts `e.__cause__` is a `requests.HTTPError` when using requests transport.
Zara: i'll update the quickstart sample and script that generates the short video snippets to show the improved error handling.
Ethan: let's also add a tiny linter rule that flags cases where we wrap and forget to set `__cause__`. avoids regressions.
Priya: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/220
Ethan: i'll review tomorrow morning. thanks for pulling this together, Priya. :sparkles:
Priya: thanks team. hoping this cuts down a bunch of the "unknown error" onboarding tickets.
